propositions: Cloud probe hardcodes RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES frozenset to {'Resolved','Done','Cancelled'} with no runtime configuration, misclassifying custom workflow status names as PRESENT_FILTERED instead of PRESENT_RESOLVED.

JiraConfig must expose resolved_statuses as a configurable list[str] field, parsed from [tool.rebar.jira] via _as_str_list coercer with REBAR_JIRA_RESOLVED_STATUSES environment override, defaulting to ['Resolved','Done','Cancelled'].

Cloud probe's classify_probe_response must resolve the status set from load_config().jira.resolved_statuses at runtime, falling back to module-level RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES when the configured list is empty, unset, or ConfigError.

Tenants configuring custom jira.resolved_statuses values must see those statuses used for classification instead of defaults, and empty configuration must fall back to defaults rather than result in an empty set.
Documentation in docs/config.md must record the new jira.resolved_statuses configuration key in the [tool.rebar.jira] block.
